children: H2O America completed the sale of 7,475,000 equity units, each with a stated amount of $50, for an aggregate stated amount of $373.75 million. The units combine stock purchase contracts requiring holders to buy company shares by November 1, 2029, with interests in 5.300% senior notes due 2031, and provide for annual distributions totaling 7.750%. The related indentures set the note terms, while a purchase contract and pledge agreement secures the share-purchase obligations with the notes.
Agreement 1: H2O America Raises $373.75 Million Through Equity Unit Offering
: Wells Fargo Securities and J.P. Morgan Securities, as representatives of the underwriters
: Stock purchase contracts settle no later than Nov 01 2029; notes mature in 2031
: Raise capital through an equity-linked securities offering
Agreement 2: H2O America Issues 5.300% Remarketable Senior Notes Due 2031
: Indenture and first supplemental indenture for 5.300% Remarketable Senior Notes
: U.S. Bank Trust Company, National Association, as trustee
: Establish terms for notes included in the equity units
Agreement 3: H2O America Establishes Stock Purchase Contracts Secured by Senior Notes
: U.S. Bank Trust Company, National Association, as purchase contract agent, collateral agent, custodial agent and securities intermediary
: Stock purchase contracts settle no later than Nov 01 2029
: Secure holders' share-purchase obligations and provide for note remarketing
